name: Osaka International Airport (Itami)

runway.v: two runways: A 1,828 m and B 3,000 m

curfew.v: no operations outside the operating hours of 07:00-21:00 local

slots.v: congested airport: flights need an MLIT congested-airport operating permit; coordination standard of 370 movements a day (07:00-21:00) and 36 an hour

notes: Read MLIT Civil Aviation Bureau 'Supplementary explanatory material for congested-airport operating permit applications, Osaka International Airport' (混雑空港運航許可申請事案補足説明資料【大阪国際空港】, 19 Nov 2024). It notes international flights ended when Kansai opened in Sep 1994; it says nothing on international business jets or customs. Jet and low-noise movement splits in the table could not be read clearly and are not recorded. The MLIT business-jet procedures PDF could not be fetched.
